top_signals.title: AI Trade Unravels; Anthropic Drops After Strong Debut
top_signals.summary: Global stocks hit their longest losing streak in more than three years. Anthropic falls in premarket trading after a blockbuster IPO as the selloff spreads across AI stocks. Katrina Dudley of Franklin Templeton joins "Bloomberg Brief" to discuss what's next for the AI trade. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
